Verdict: CHANGES-REQUESTED
- [P2] tests/scripts/test_docs_site_sync_links.py:163: subprocess.run invokes `node sync-docs.js` in a stripped tmp tree (only docs/ + scripts/ + a few ../ sources copied); missing node_modules/deps will cause runtime failures or silent partial syncs.
- [P2] tests/scripts/test_docs_site_sync_links.py:145: root_source_files logic only handles entries starting with "../"; any DOC_MAP entry using a different relative form will be omitted from the temp workspace and produce false mismatches.
- [P2] tests/scripts/test_docs_site_sync_links.py:128: new test now requires Node.js + sync-docs.js runtime in the test env (previously absent), introducing an undeclared CI dependency and potential flakiness.
